text:
Maya: Following up from the all-hands Q&A — leadership asked for a concise table of GA/beta dates, owners, and any non-negotiable blockers for API, Console, and Optimize. I'll collect replies here so we can hand this to Sales/Support.
Tom: API summary: aiming for "phase-1 GA" at start of Q3 (rough window: 4-6 weeks). Phase-1 = stable billing surface + SLA + core endpoints (chat, completions, embeddings). Owners: Tom (platform) + Harpreet (API). Top blockers: final SLA legal terms, pricing sign-off, and one concurrency regression in gateway that causes <1% tail errors under mixed streaming.
Harpreet: Concurrency bug detail: reproduces when 30% long-poll streams run with bursts of short calls. Patch in review, tests passing locally. If CI is green I can push to staging today. Plan: validate with a 48h staging soak.
Zoe: Console scope clarification: leadership expects "admin & rollout GA" by mid-Q3. That includes dashboards, per-route model settings, and the rollout UI. Excluded from this scope: Optimize recommendations UI, full quantization controls, and optional APM integrations (these move to Q4). Owner: Zoe (console PM).
Ben: Optimize engine update: public beta target = late-Q3, GA = Q4. Need 3 more production evals and a minimal UI that surfaces expected cost delta for suggested knobs. Blocker: infra quota for per-tenant batched experiments and one evaluation dataset gap. Owner: Ben + Research.
Maya: Risk rating (ask for leadership): which of these are "must not slip" vs "deferable"? Please annotate responses with MUST / CAN_DEFER so we can prioritize resources.
Tom: MUST: SLA legal signoff and billing surface. CAN_DEFER: 3rd-party APM links, noncritical analytics widgets.
Zoe: MUST: rollout UI + model pinning for GA. CAN_DEFER: advanced quantization controls and Optimize integration.
Harpreet: CI looks good; I'll start staging rollout and post results here. If staging fails, contingency = revert and open a hotfix cycle (2d).
Ben: I'll queue the remaining evals and request the quota bump from infra today — ETA 5 business days. If quota isn't approved, Optimize beta shifts to late-Q3 -> early-Q4.
Maya: Action items captured: 1) Harpreet to promote gateway patch to staging and post soak results (48h). 2) Tom to coordinate finance/legal for pricing & SLA deadlines (need clarity in 10 business days). 3) Zoe to publish Console GA scope doc and mark deferrables. 4) Ben to request infra quota and schedule evals. 5) Ops to publish canary thresholds and rollback rules.
ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync scheduled Wed 09:00 PT.
Zoe: I'll put the Console scope doc into the shared roadmap folder and tag everyone by EOD.
Harpreet: Staging promotion started — will update with soak metrics in ~48h. :rocket:
